async def act(page):
    # Filter for cancelled orders by selecting 'Canceled' in the status combobox
    # The status combobox is in the filter row, which is the second row in the rowgroup of the orders table
    # Use .get_by_role() with exact names from the tree
    status_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Status')
    await status_combobox.select_option(label='Canceled')
    # Click the 'Search' button to apply the filter
    search_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for the table to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    # Sort by 'Purchased On' in descending order to get the most recent
    # Click the 'Purchased On' link twice to ensure descending sort
    purchased_on_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Purchased On')
    await purchased_on_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    await purchased_on_link.click()
    # Wait for the table to update after sorting
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    # Extract the date from the first data row (skip the header and filter rows)
    # The first data row is after the header row and filter row; in the tree, data rows start from index 2 in rowgroup
    # Use .nth(2) to get the first data row (index 0 is header, index 1 is filter row)
    first_data_row = page.get_by_role('row').nth(2)
    # Get the cell containing the date; in the tree, the date is in the fourth cell (index 3) of each data row
    date_cell = first_data_row.get_by_role('cell').nth(3)
    date_text = await date_cell.text_content()
    # Return the date text
    return date_text.strip()
